<div class="card-body">
'''Laser Gate''' is a [[Dark]] [[Device]] ([[Item]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">レーザー・ゲート</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">任意の2枚の、移動要塞の屋内の位置カードの境界に配備する。ここを通るためには、各キャラクターは（戦闘力＋能力値）＞4であるか、「リフト・チューブ」を使用する必要がある。それ以外のビークルはすべて移動を妨げられる。レーザー・ゲートは装甲値＝3。両側の位置カードから個人用兵器の目標とすることができる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Laser-Gate-PSA-97065197.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">保安区画の回廊には多数のレーザーが装備されている。必要に応じてこれを格子状に張りめぐらせて、重要区画への敵の侵入を阻止する。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Laser Gate.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy at the boundary between any two interior location cards of a mobile fortress. To pass, each character must have combined power and ability greater than 4 or use Lift Tube. All other vehicles are blocked. Laser Gate has armor 3. A personal weapon can target it from a location card on either side.

'''Lore:'''
Security corridors are equipped with many lasers. They can form a grid to keep enemies out of sensitive areas when necessary.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face says “interior location cards of a mobile fortress” and “personal weapon.”
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Laser Gate]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
